subject: POC onramp: environment handoff, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@beacondx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC onramp: environment handoff, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Alex —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our MAP discussion, I wanted to summarize the minimal handoff checklist so your infra team can start scheduling: 

- Org + team setup: we’ll create a BeaconDX org in our Private Console and invite two engineers (ops@beacondx.com, alex@beacondx.com).
- API keys: we’ll provision two scoped service API keys (read+infer; limited admin) and deliver via DocuSign-protected envelope.
- IP allowlist: BeaconDX to confirm the outbound NAT ranges to allow (we need CIDR list to populate allowlist).
- VPC peering: exchange VPC IDs and contact windows; peering template attached.
- MAP milestones: target environment activation (internal smoke) in 5 business days, production-like trial in 10–12 business days.

Attachments: map-draft-v1.pdf (MAP milestones), vpc-peering-template.txt, network-allowlist.csv (example CSV).

Next steps: Can you confirm the two engineer emails and whether your security team needs a SOC2 artefact before we share the API keys? If yes, I’ll loop in Marissa to attach the SOC2 summary.

Thanks —
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex@beacondx.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: infra-team@beacondx.com
Date: 2026-08-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC onramp: environment handoff, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Avery —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers from our side: 

- Confirming engineer contacts: Alex Chen (alex@beacondx.com), Infra Team (infra-team@beacondx.com).
- SOC2: we’d like the SOC2 summary before keys are provisioned; happy to accept the condensed PDF.
- IP ranges: we can provide 3 CIDR blocks — attaching a draft (will send final CSV by EOD).
- VPC peering: good to know the template; can your network ops join a call Wednesday morning (PDT)?

One more ask: do you provide short-lived scoped keys for the integration so we can avoid storing long-lived secrets in our CI?

Cheers,
Alex
Head of Infrastructure
BeaconDX

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: BeaconDX MAP — keys, SOC2, peering window

Soojin / Karthik —

Looping you both to confirm operational bits for BeaconDX POC:

- SOC2 summary: Alex requested condensed SOC2 artefact before we hand over API keys. Marissa, can we produce a 1–2 pager (scope: hosted API access, data retention/segregation) and attach to the DocuSign packet?
- API keys: BeaconDX prefers short-lived scoped tokens. Do we have a standard 24–72h token workflow we can enable for this account, or do we need a manual workaround?
- VPC peering timeline: they asked for a Wed morning call (PDT). Karthik, can you confirm if network ops can join Wednesday 09:00–10:00 PDT?

I’ll reply to Alex when I have the SOC2 note and confirmation on token TTL.

Avery

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BeaconDX MAP — keys, SOC2, peering window

Avery —

Short answers:

- SOC2 summary: attaching "SOC2-summary-poc.pdf" to the DocuSign packet is fine — I’ll prep a bulletized version (controls scoped to inference API, retention, access logs). Marissa, will need your sign-off on the language.
- Short-lived tokens: we support ephemeral keys via our dev token service. Default TTL is 24h; we can extend to 72h for the POC. For CI integration we can issue a scoped service account + ephemeral refresh.
- VPC peering: network ops confirmed Wed 2026-08-18 09:00–09:45 PDT (they have a 45m slot). Karthik will lead the peering config; Karthik, please use the attached vpc-peering-template.txt and confirm required fields (VPC ID, region, routing table entries).

Attachments referenced in-thread: vpc-peering-template.txt (filled example), SOC2-summary-poc.pdf (draft).

— Soojin
SRE & Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@beacondx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC onramp: environment handoff, API keys, IP allowlist & VPC peering

Alex —

Great — thanks for the confirm. To recap and lock the timeline: 

1) SOC2 summary: Soojin will send the 1‑pager this afternoon; we’ll include that in a DocuSign packet before issuing keys.
2) API keys: we’ll deliver two scoped ephemeral keys (24h TTL by default, can extend to 72h for your CI). We’ll provide instructions on rotating with the refresh flow.
3) IP allowlist: please send final CIDR list as network-allowlist.csv (we received your draft; final by EOD tomorrow is perfect).
4) VPC peering call: scheduled for Wed 2026-08-18 09:00–09:45 PDT — Karthik and Soojin will join. Karthik, please bring the filled vpc-peering-template.txt.

Milestones in MAP (attached map-draft-v1.pdf):
- Day 0 (today): MAP sign and SOC2 note attached to DocuSign.
- Day 2: API keys provisioned and allowlist applied.
- Day 5: internal smoke tests and validation.
- Day 10–12: production-like trial with sample traffic.

If that timeline works, I’ll send the DocuSign for signatures and the HubSpot milestone update.

Thanks — looking forward to getting BeaconDX fully onboarded.

Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
